remarks: Turn-key, move-in ready modern townhouse located in the heart of downtown New Canaan, this home offers three floors of elegant living with the feel of a single-family residence and the convenience of low-maintenance living. The renovated open floor plan features a state of the art newer chef's kitchen, a breakfast nook, island, and a light-filled living room/dining room with a fireplace. Sunny open floor plan highlights the state-of-the-art fully equipped kitchen, breakfast room, family/dining room w/ fireplace. First floor 2-story office with fireplace & built-ins makes working from home a breeze. The luxe primary bedroom with ensuite bath, boasts high end finishes, soaking tub, heated floors & 2-WIC. The lower level has an extra 1,000+ of play or recreation area - there is even a projector for game day and movies! The walk-out lower level leads to a private patio and yard with lawn, trees, foliage making it the ideal to walk to Mead Park, the bird sanctuary, the magic circle of town, train and schools. Experience this fully-renovated, move in ready modern, 3-story townhouse, that lives like a single family home, in sought after in-town location! Simply the best rental offering!
